body: Human selected: correct the documentation. The disputed behaviour is therefore observed, not inferred, and it matches the code rather than the documentation.U+000AU+000ATwo delivery-leads dispatched in parallel, one per repository, because the identical stale sentence exists in two places:U+000AU+002D logbook, branch `docs/scope-is-stored-not-derived`, worktree-isolated, correcting `docs/rules/continuity-ledger.md:126-127`. Fenced to Markdown; forbidden to touch src or test, since the three sites pinning the shipped behaviour must stay passing untouched. Documentation-only changes are exempt from the test admission gate, so no test is written.U+000AU+002D .windful-ocean, branch `docs/scope-is-stored-not-derived`, correcting `.claude/rules/common/continuity-ledger.md:131`. A PR is mandatory there because the repo blocks direct pushes to main and the rule takes effect across every project the moment it lands.U+000AU+000AEach lead is told to sweep its whole file for other repetitions of the same false promise and report the count, and each is told to stay out of the other repository so the two do not collide.U+000AU+000AAlso filed out of scope, as a background chip rather than folded into this thread: a decision with no scope renders as a bare empty bracket pair at `src/server/resource-render.ts:133-134` in the logbook://thread/{id} resource, with no test covering it.U+000AU+000Ac1 lead still running; nothing known about it yet.
